instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes the bridge program with required state accounts.
This function sets up the initial bridge configuration and must be called once during deployment.
# Arguments
* `ctx`      - The context containing all accounts needed for initialization, including the guardian signer
* `guardian` - The guardian account that will have administrative authority over the bridge
* `cfg`      - All the configuration parameters needed to initialize the bridge

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: The upgrade authority that is authorized to initialize the bridge.
This ensures only the program deployer can set the initial configuration.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The account that pays for the transaction and bridge account creation.
Must be mutable to deduct lamports for account rent.
Can be different from the upgrade_authority.

accounts.name: bridge
docs: The bridge state account being initialized.
- Uses PDA with BRIDGE_SEED for deterministic address
- Payer funds the account creation
- Space allocated for bridge state (DISCRIMINATOR_LEN + Bridge::INIT_SPACE)

accounts.name: program_data
docs: Program data account containing the upgrade authority.
Validates that the signer is indeed the upgrade authority.

accounts.name: program
docs: The bridge program itself.
Validates that program_data is the correct ProgramData account for this program.

accounts.name: system_program
docs: System program required for creating new accounts.
Used internally by Anchor for account initialization.

fields.name: eip1559_config
docs: Configuration parameters for EIP-1559-inspired fee calculations

fields.name: gas_config
docs: Configuration parameters for outgoing message pricing

fields.name: protocol_config
docs: Configuration parameters for bridge protocol

fields.name: buffer_config
docs: Configuration parameters for pre-loading Solana --> Base messages in buffer accounts

fields.name: partner_oracle_config
docs: Partner oracle configuration containing the required signature threshold

fields.name: base_oracle_config
docs: Configuration parameters for Base oracle signers

fields.name: config
docs: Configuration parameters for EIP-1559-inspired fee calculations

fields.name: current_base_fee
docs: Current base fee used in fee computation (runtime state).
Unitless value combined with `gas_per_call` and gas cost scaler to produce lamports.

fields.name: current_window_gas_used
docs: Gas used in the current time window (runtime state)

fields.name: window_start_time
docs: Unix timestamp when the current window started (runtime state)

fields.name: target
docs: Gas target per window

fields.name: denominator
docs: Adjustment denominator (controls rate of change)

fields.name: window_duration_seconds
docs: Window duration in seconds

fields.name: minimum_base_fee
docs: Minimum base fee. Used to seed `current_base_fee` at initialization
and as an underflow clamp during decreases; not enforced as a strict lower bound
on every step.

fields.name: gas_cost_scaler
docs: Scaling factor applied when converting (gas_per_call * base_fee) into lamports

fields.name: gas_cost_scaler_dp
docs: Decimal precision for the gas cost scaler (denominator)

fields.name: gas_fee_receiver
docs: Account that receives gas fees collected on Solana

fields.name: gas_per_call
docs: Amount of gas per Solana --> Base message

fields.name: required_threshold
docs: Partner signatures required by our bridge to accept an output root

fields.name: block_interval_requirement
docs: Block interval requirement for output root registration. Every Base block associated with a
submitted output root must be a multiple of this number.

fields.name: remote_sol_address
docs: The Base evm address of SOL
